result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my recommendation would be **Xero** as the best all-round accounting software.

However, depending on your business size, whether you employ staff, and how you invoice customers, **MYOB or QuickBooks might be a better fit.**

Here's how I'd compare the main options in 2026.

## Best accounting software compared

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

From \$37 AUD/month

- Easy to use and learn.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- GST and BAS reporting.
- Payroll and superannuation.
- Excellent accountant and app integrations.

Best for: Most small businesses, contractors and growing companies.

[Xero website and plans](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and inventory)

From \$99 AUD/year for Solo; Business Lite \$315/year after introductory offer

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features.
- Good inventory management.
- BAS and GST management.
- Good for businesses with employees.

Best for: Retail, trades and businesses with more complex payroll or stock.

[MYOB website and plans](https://www.myob.com/au/pricing)

---

![Quickbooks Online — Columbus Business Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z_-lMr1rk7nVCnHpykvHbFlLn1azsDdLq1E5IPLLHaY_8oSNYyauUS0LtpVtMtsr7aGmH36ThTapoKB2Ph5Q3eMVc_UXwvW966z4ZTJF_6xHgqWw4BiwFU5MO1xbGE5oY_mXKemXduz1fPiAwGEyT1jt_IjAl-f9situ1bcy769twmRe-HD-uB1wI8CWqiLV?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

From approximately \$33 AUD/month

- Straightforward bookkeeping.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Financial reporting.
- Useful for smaller operations.

Best for: Freelancers, consultants and businesses wanting straightforward bookkeeping.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon One Reviews in 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dCRyYblOVFHGJ_BOS5qicICX8a3EdGZtwRdBaTl5VxvzN4yHbl45lRfb_fHgLDgFhK2WkaF6RtgxgeGyC3VAqL_5ryKMjnfRJOzRjj39UY9Gwo6c2sujBvWwCH_4BBzQyb-ImkSZIwMNsmdCK7Ei0If6xm6IKW39XFFbAhuiPgv9Niq4MJdei2SmNmc-t9Mf?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon One**

From approximately \$27 AUD/month

- Affordable accounting.
- GST and BAS management.
- Bank feeds and invoicing.
- Modular features.

Best for: Smaller businesses wanting to keep accounting costs down.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

Pricing is indicative; promotions and plan limits can change. [www.xero.com](https://www.xero.com/au/pricing-plans/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.myob.com](https://www.myob.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.reckon.com](https://www.reckon.com/au/accounting-software/compare/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarehq.com.au](https://www.softwarehq.com.au/guides/accounting-cost-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical Australian small business, I'd start with Xero.

The main reason is that it combines bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, invoicing, GST, BAS and payroll in one system, with a large ecosystem of accountants and business apps.
